max_bpf_progs.description: Maximum number of BPF programs (functions) that bpftrace can generate

max_probes.description: Maximum number of probes that bpftrace can attach to

max_map_keys.description: Maximum number of keys that can be stored in a map

max_strlen.description: Maximum length (in bytes) for values created by str(), buf(), and path()

cache_user_symbols.description: Caching strategy for user symbols (PER_PROGRAM, PER_PID, or NONE)

stack_mode.description: Output format for ustack and kstack builtins (bpftrace, perf, or raw)

max_cpus.description: Maximum number of CPUs to use (0 = auto)

perf_rb_pages.description: Number of pages to allocate per CPU perf ring buffer (must be power of 2)

on_stack_limit.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of individual objects stored on the BPF stack

max_cat_bytes.description: Maximum bytes read by cat builtin

missing_probes.description: Handling for probes with multiple attach points (error, warn, or ignore)

kernel_build.description: Directory containing kernel build artifacts (for out-of-tree builds)

kernel_release.description: Kernel release version (used to compute kernel_source and kernel_build defaults)

vmlinux_path.description: Path to the vmlinux file for kernel symbol resolution

user_symbol_paths.description: Colon-separated list of directories for user symbol resolution

str_trunc_trailer.description: Trailer to add to truncated strings

lazy_symbolication.description: Enable lazy symbolication for user-space symbols

max_type_res_iterations.description: Maximum levels of nested field accesses for tracepoint args

symbol_source.description: Source for uprobe symbol resolution (dwarf or symbol_table)
